title: Evaluating Explanations: An Explanatory Virtues Framework for Mechanistic Interpretability
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally centered on epistemology (a subfield of philosophy). It introduces a framework for theory choice and 'explanatory virtues' drawing from major philosophical perspectives (Kuhnian, Bayesian, Deutschian, and Nomological) to evaluate the truth-conduciveness and quality of scientific explanations in the context of AI interpretability.
